Pixel Bubble Sort

Ten bars. One comparison per step.

Press Step to compare two bars.

# Pixel Bubble Sort Visualizer

An offline, dependency-free browser app that visualizes bubble sort on 10 randomly sized bars.

## Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server, packages, or network requests are needed.

## Controls

- **Shuffle** — generates 10 new random bar heights and resets the sort.
- **Step** — performs exactly one comparison (and swap if needed), highlighting the two compared bars.
- When the bars are fully sorted, a completion message appears and Step is disabled.

All controls are keyboard-accessible with visible focus states.

## Files

- `index.html` — page structure
- `style.css` — pixel-themed styling and responsive layout
- `script.js` — bar rendering and bubble sort state machine
